snippet.title: Release Trailer | Halo: GoldSource
snippet.description:
After 11 months in Beta, tomorrow (2025-06-27), Halo: GoldSource leaves beta. With bug fixes, map enhancements, and more, this is version 1.0. It doesn't end here; there's so much more to come.
